headline: SPACEX 🍆 CATCHES HUGE STARSHIP 🍑 TOP with CHOPSTICKS 😩💦
text:
WHAT 😳 THE 😳 F*CK 😳 is UP all you StarSHIP 🪐🍆 GOONERS 🖥️🤤
🚀💦 SPACEX just caught 🪝🤏 its massive 🍆🍆 124m StarSHIP 🛸🍑 mid-air with those 🦾 giant mechanical chopSTICKS 🥢🍆 after a sweaty 💦 2️⃣2️⃣.5️⃣ hour flight 🌌😩 The upper 🪜 stage hovered 🪩 like a THROBBING 🍆 tip 😳 right by the launch 🏗️ tower while 🫳 the chopSTICKS 🦾 gripped and secured 🤲 it tight 🫳🍆‼️ They tried 🤞 for the SuperHEAVY 🦿 booster too 🚀 but it got low on fuel ⛽😭 aborted and went 🏊 straight for a wet ocean splashdown 💦🌊 before exploding in a fiery 🔥 BUST 💥🍆 Elon posted 📱 the booster 🦿 was "slightly ⬇️ low" which 🔑 is code for premature 💦 launch problems 😏 The Ship 🛸 still deployed 📡 2️⃣6️⃣ Starlink satellites 🛰️ then did 🌍 1️⃣4️⃣ full orbits 🪐 before sliding 🛬 back for its first 🥇 successful chopSTICK 🫳 catch 🥢😍 This was test 🧪 1️⃣5️⃣ and the first 🥇 time they grabbed 🫳 the upper 🪜 stage after it reached 🌌 orbit 🌍🚀 NASA and shareholders 👀 are watching 📺 this reusable ♻️ rocket HANDJOB 🍆 closely because 🫳 fully catching 🫳 both halves 🪜🦿 means cheaper 💰 repeated rides to the Moon 🌕💦

Get 0️⃣ back, you're a splashdown loser 🌊😭
Get 5️⃣ back, your booster 🦿 stays hard for 6️⃣.5️⃣ minutes ⏳🍆
Get 1️⃣0️⃣+ back, chopSTICKS grab your StarSHIP 🛸 tonight 🥢💦
